description: This file defines the ForbiddenException class used for handling forbidden access errors within the OrangeHRM API, version 2. It extends the base Exception class and implements ValidationEscapableException, providing a default error message and constructor.

classes.name: ForbiddenException
classes.description: Custom exception class representing a forbidden (unauthorized) error in the API, with a default error message.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the exception with a default or custom message, code, and previous exception.
